reference_basis.documented: Named-host remote numeric/string registers, independent comments, logical port values and simulation; numeric selected outputs and BOOLEAN simulation query
reference_basis.conflicts: Parameter tables label some register numbers BOOLEAN, numeric flag INTEGER, comment strings INTEGER and string-register write value output; details/examples support INTEGER numbers, BOOLEAN flag, STRING comments and input STRING writes

implementation_choices.context: Explicit PeerBanks host-to-bank mapping; numeric, strings, positions and ports only; no nested contexts, callbacks, credentials, files or tasks
implementation_choices.identity: Case-insensitive ASCII host labels, 1..254 characters, starting alphanumeric with underscore/dot/colon/hyphen allowed; no DNS or sockets
implementation_choices.sharing: Copied host/service mappings deliberately share supplied typed bank objects; JSON export is detached and reload creates fresh banks
implementation_choices.values: INTEGER/REAL numeric kinds and selected read outputs; peer/destination string capacities; 16-character comments; INTEGER port values with BOOLEAN 0/1 conversions and BOOLEAN simulation output
implementation_choices.isolation: Only selected peer bank and its explicit port type_codes; no caller-bank fallback or automatic peer creation
implementation_choices.status: Portable 0 success, 1 absent value, 2 invalid address, 3 invalid port conversion, 4 unsimulated input write, PEER_UNAVAILABLE=5 for unbound host; missing context/bank/mapping raises before mutation
implementation_choices.guards: Source-ordered once-only arguments, checked disjoint exact writable outputs, selected read preparation, read-only and transitive FOR protections; prior completed effects retained
implementation_choices.persistence: peers JSON uses existing typed bank schemas; preserves kinds, capacities, comments, positions and I/O state/configuration; no object identity, task state or pending pulses
implementation_choices.reports: remote_bank_policy, service_operations and defensive value-free service requests; no local numeric register request records for remote calls

retained_boundaries: No real networking, controller discovery, native RPCC transport/error/timing equivalence or live acquisition
Position banks supply comments; remote position-value transfer and remote program/task execution remain separate gaps
Ordinary local behavior and guards remain; strict mode is a future milestone
